description: Shared org preset for tpsdev-ai repositories. Establishes the supply-chain posture: pin version updates, enforce a 7-day bake-time cooldown, and assign group names to minor, patch, pin and digest updates for the listed matchManagers: bun, npm, pep621, pip_requirements, pip_setup, poetry, github-actions, dockerfile and docker-compose; the one major update it groups is the CodeQL Action (github-actions manager), assigned the group name `github/codeql-action` by a rule placed after the majors rule. Every update is proposal-only (automerge: false) — it must pass the full CI suite + K&S review before merge. See https://github.com/tpsdev-ai/flair/blob/main/docs/supply-chain-policy.md. Docker image digest pins are PROPOSED via Renovate's docker:pinDigests preset for Dockerfiles, compose files and workflow container/service images (in current Renovate the preset exempts argocd, devcontainer, helmv3 and pyenv); like every update here they are PRs, never automerged, so the protection — a republished tag cannot change the bytes we build or test on — holds for an image once its pin PR is merged.

packageRules.description: Assign minor, patch, pin and digest updates for the bun and npm managers the group name non-major npm dependencies.
Assign minor, patch, pin and digest updates for the pep621, pip_requirements, pip_setup and poetry managers the group name non-major python dependencies.
Set groupName: null for major updates.
The preset assigns CodeQL Action major updates (github-actions manager) the group name github/codeql-action.
Assign minor, patch, pin and digest updates for the github-actions manager the group name github-actions.
Assign minor, patch, pin and digest updates for the dockerfile and docker-compose managers the group name non-major docker dependencies.

schedule: before 9am on the first day of the month
